services.name: Sailboat Rides
services.desc: Rates Person: $30 About SET SAIL out on the Atlantic Ocean with one of our professional and experienced sailors on staff who guarantee your group a safe, fun-filled, and exciting trip. These private sailboat rides are one of the most uniquely thrilling and affordable activities to do while in Myrtle Beach. No prior experience is required for our Sailboat rides and smiles are always guaranteed. Our extensive fleets of Hobie Cats hold up to 4 people and are always kept up to speed with quality and dependable maintenance routines to ensure your security while out on the water. With this being said, our sailing excursions are always strongly dependent on the weather, wind, and water conditions.
